craft_notes: Sthāyin: weak-power (the smallest instrument works). Rows: row 3 (entered→freedom won). Close: won (āpnuyāt - same verb family as v49 — refrain of winning). Rejected: 'kundalini' — killed: power kept; 'ascends' — killed: entered kept (praviśya is entry, not rise).

lines: Thin, weak power meditated at twelve's range,
l4.sanskrit_cite: pināṃ ca durbalāṃ śaktiṃ dhyātvā dvādaśagocare | praviśya hṛdaye dhyāyan muktaḥ svātantryam āpnuyāt

reads_against.argmap: What does the weak power do? → Entering heart with the weak power at the twelve-range wins freedom.
c1_essence: Weak power at twelve-range, heart-entered: freedom won.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
